data.title: Passing one map doesn't make it right
story: Yesterday's turn-right program passed on map 1 and went straight to every warehouse. Now the robot spins around in corridors that turn left.
Write a find_corridor() function with def: try turning left first, and if there is still a wall in front, turn right twice. Test it on all three maps!

explanation: Maps 2 and 3 are edge cases that were never tested: left turns. find_corridor() tries left first and then right, and testing the program on every map proves the fix.
hints: Look at map 2: which way does the corridor turn? What does the old program do there?
def find_corridor(): then an indented body: turn_left(), then if not front_clear(): turn_right() twice.
Replace turn_right() in the else branch with find_corridor().
